scenes.say: For one night race in Las Vegas, drivers paint a whole new helmet. Here are the wildest.
Esteban Ocon in twenty twenty-three: all red, with eyes on top. That's the Deadpool mask.
Lando Norris for his hundred and fiftieth Grand Prix: raised hand painting with scenes from his best races.
Yuki Tsunoda went for kintsugi: a lid that looks like ceramic, with the cracks filled in gold.
Ocon back with the comics: one half Spider-Man, the other half Venom.
And for this year's race, Red Bull has already shown Verstappen's lid: blue and covered in glitter.
We'll show the rest once they're revealed. Follow the race on LapRadar.

title: The wildest Las Vegas Grand Prix helmets: from Deadpool to kintsugi
